Good-ending template (מ:סיום בטוב)

← Back to Reading MAM-parsed-plain

This template marks the unpointed next-to-last verse used in the good-ending recitation tradition. In plain format, a simple use can appear as a stringified template.

In practice, this template may be nested inside larger template structures (for example inside נוסח), but the core plain representation is shown below.

{
  "stmpl": "מ:סיום בטוב|והיה מדי ... אמר יהוה"
}
